name: product-recap
description: Turn one or more repos' git history into a product-evolution story and a single-file HTML slide deck. Run from any directory: inside a git repo it mines local clones on the canonical branch (origin/default); outside a repo it resolves the repo from natural language against the Mercaso org and mines master. Merge sibling repos into one deck, scope to a sub-path, pick a time window (open-ended or a closed range); verify flows in code, narrate for non-engineers, build and visually verify the deck.
